name: smoke
description: L1 smoke test template: the app answers, the Operator is attached, a sample loads, no window is stuck on a loading title, the eye view can be captured. Replace the myapp_* tools with your app's. Run: python run_scenario.py smoke.json --prefix myapp --project <project>

steps.symptom: the app never registers its tools: Play Mode did not start, or the OpenXR instance never came up
the demo sample never finishes loading
a window title is stuck on 'Downloading 100%' after the load finished
